definitions.short: Shekanjah , the name of nine Israelites
definitions.full: H7935. Shekanyah or Shekanyahu ( שְׁכַנְיָ֫ה(וּׅ ) proper name, masculine ( ׳י hath taken up his abode ); — שְׁכַנְיָה , Σεχενια ( ς ), etc.: 1 descendant of Jehoiakin 1Chr 3:21-22 , (on context see Kit), Ezra 8:3 , 5 . 2 Ezra 10:2 (different from 1 ?). 3 father of a wall-builder Neh 3:29 . 4 father-in-law of Tobiah Neh 6:18 . 5 priestly name: a. Neh 12:3 = שְׁכַנְיָ֫הוּ 1Chr 24:11 , compare שְׁכַנְיָה 3 Neh 10:5 ; 12:14 . b. שְׁכַנְיָ֫הוּ 2Chr 31:15 .
